description.value: The Captain's Boil is a seafood boil franchise restaurant on Vancouver's busy Robson Street in the West End, serving fresh seafood feasts where diners choose their catch, flavour sauce, and heat level. The hands-on, bag-style dining format is designed for group feasting. The Robson Street location is wheelchair accessible and sits on a major pedestrian and cycling corridor.
